description.value: Laksa King is a family-run Malaysian and Burmese restaurant on East Hastings Street in East Vancouver, helmed by chef-owner Daisy who brings authentic Southeast Asian home cooking — including laksa, mee goreng, and Burmese salads — to the neighbourhood. The menu spans Malaysian, Burmese, Thai, Singaporean, and Taiwanese Fu-Jian styles, all freshly prepared in a home-cooked tradition. Every dish can be customized for vegan, vegetarian, and varying spice preferences, making it a flexible stop for cyclists with dietary needs.
